10782|3ab7bddd.name: Royal Factor Bathrilor
10782|3ab7bddd.text:
Welcome to Stormwind!  I am one of the city's officers, aiding the citizenry of the city through our census bureau.  If you are in need of locating someone specific, then I might be able to assist you.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.

If you have business with me, then please proceed!

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1307|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1308|0624ab70.name: Owen Vaughn
1308|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1432|e214cf62.name: Renato Gallina
1432|e214cf62.text: Hey, mister.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

15310|d11310f6.name: Jesper
15310|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

263349|53fff4bc.name: James Battlewing
263349|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

6740|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

8311-accept.name: Jesper
8311-accept.text:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little $r named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8311-accept.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8356-accept.name: Innkeeper Allison
8356-accept.text:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong man!

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Stormwind Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
8356-accept.title: Flexing for Nougat

8356-complete.name: Innkeeper Allison
8356-complete.text:
You are truly mighty, haha!  Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport.  Here's your candy.

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8356-complete.title: Flexing for Nougat

97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons
